name: anycable-atomic-multi-command-controller-8d4a
instr:
Allow callers to execute an ordered mix of subscription, unsubscription, and perform commands as one atomic batch. Batch evaluation may span different controller behaviors, but runtime membership, presence, broadcasts, and outbound frames become visible only as one committed result.

A non-empty `BatchRequest` produces positionally aligned `BatchCommandResult` values carrying the original IDs; invalid input fails at its position before evaluation or side effects, using `ErrEmptyBatch` with "empty command batch" or `ErrInvalidBatchCommand` with "invalid batch command" from `github.com/anycable/anycable-go/common`. Every `node.Controller` stops at the first failure, preserves prior outcomes and the failed position, and exposes no node-owned effects while evaluating. RPC preserves ordered retries and conversion under one deadline; routing selects routed or fallback handling per item, including nil-result fallback; identity delegation neither reauthenticates nor alters results. Pusher presence, signed streams, gobench broadcasts and metrics, and null rejection retain their existing per-command semantics within ordered outcomes. `Node.HandleBatch` commits session, hub, broker, presence, broadcast, and transmission effects all-or-nothing, compensating completed ownership changes after publication failure while preserving the primary error and reporting compensation failure.
